name: Adamya Singh
shortQuote: Outstanding intern — proactive, responsive, and high-impact contributor.
fullText: It is my pleasure to recommend Gyanesh for his outstanding contributions as an intern on the IBM Sterling Order Management Product Management team. During his two-month tenure, Gyanesh quickly distinguished himself as a proactive, responsive, and high-impact contributor. His ability to rapidly grasp complex concepts, identify opportunities to add value, and deliver high-quality solutions was remarkable. Gyanesh took ownership of in-depth competitive analyses for strategic deals, providing actionable insights that strengthened our go-to-market strategy. He also collaborated cross-functionally to streamline over 1,200 business-critical RFP questions, showcasing his strong research skills and ability to drive efficiency...
